description: Numbered step cards explaining a workflow or onboarding sequence. More structured than Features3Col. Two layouts: 'horizontal' (cards in a row, ideal for 3-4 steps) and 'stacked' (stacked cards, ideal for 5+ or longer descriptions).

title.hint: 5-10 words. Often 'How it works' / 'Our process' / 'Three steps to launch'.

steps.hint: 3-6 steps. Each: { title (3-6 words), description (1-2 sentences, 15-30 words), icon? (single emoji, used only when numbered=false) }.

numbered.hint: Show 01/02/03 chips on each step. Set false to use icon prop instead.

preview.title: From prompt to live site in three steps.
preview.description: No code, no agency, no scaffolding from scratch.

steps.title: Describe your business
steps.description: Tell LanderPilot what you do, who it's for, and what visitors should do next.

steps.title: Pick a theme + sections
steps.description: The AI assembles a draft from the section library and your chosen industry theme.

steps.title: Preview, polish, deploy
steps.description: Open the live preview, iterate in plain language, deploy to Cloudflare with one click.
